definitions.explanation: Describes speech or language ability that is smooth and natural, without hesitation or awkwardness.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{流暢|りゅうちょう}な{英語|えいご}を{話|はな}す。
{流暢|りゅうちょう}に{日本語|にほんご}を{話|はな}す{外国人|がいこくじん}に{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the foreigner who spoke Japanese fluently.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}して{三年|さんねん}になるが、まだ{流暢|りゅうちょう}とは{言|い}えない。
examples.english: It's been three years since I went abroad to study, but I still can't say I'm fluent.

notes:
A na-adjective describing smooth, natural speech without hesitation. Almost exclusively used about language ability.

FORMS:
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な + noun: {流暢|りゅうちょう}な{英語|えいご} (fluent English)
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}に + verb: {流暢|りゅうちょう}に{話|はな}す (to speak fluently)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な{日本語|にほんご}: fluent Japanese
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}に{話|はな}す: to speak fluently
- {流暢|りゅうちょう}な{発音|はつおん}: fluent pronunciation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペラペラ: fluent (casual, onomatopoeic — ペラペラ{話|はな}す)
- {堪能|たんのう}: proficient, skilled (broader — not limited to speaking)

{流暢|りゅうちょう} focuses specifically on speaking smoothness and is more formal than ペラペラ.
